improvements.reason: Missing sealed inputs are a dependency-unavailable JSON 503, matching the other sealed detail routes, instead of an unhandled plain-text 500.
A negative proximity band is invalid client input and returns a JSON validation 422 before a handler, not a plain-text 500.
An identifier outside the storage adapter's Int64 range is refused with JSON validation 422 instead of overflowing during a store operation.
Absolute magnitude above 10000 is refused with JSON validation 422 before any computation. The omitted unbounded recording must not hang the replacement host.
